description: The v1 49-query code-search benchmark corpus, imported implementation-neutrally. Query strings and ground-truth targets are kept VERBATIM from v1 so the benchmark stays comparable (baseline on v1, gate on v2 — 14 §7 [FIXED]). Matching semantics: file = substring of the target file path; symbol = substring of the target symbol name; symbol=null means file-level match (any symbol).

provenance.ref: const QUERIES: BenchQuery[] (lines 56-133); scoring in evaluateModel (lines 438-453)
provenance.note: v1 schema {query, expectedFile, expectedName} -> {query, expected.file, expected.symbol}. expectedName === '' -> symbol=null. Single relevant target per query; no graded relevance judgments (registered gap).
